nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the current riddle question.
Address that set the current question; acts as the owner used for access control in StopGame, NewQuestion and newQuestioner.
keccak256 hash of the expected answer; writable only once in set_game but overwritable by the owner in NewQuestion.
External payable function that checks the answer against responseHash, verifies msg.sender == tx.origin and msg.value > 3 ether, then transfers the whole balance.
Payable initializer that sets responseHash, question and questionSender only when responseHash is still zero.
Payable owner-only function that sends this.balance to msg.sender.
Payable owner-only function that replaces question and responseHash.
Owner-only function that transfers the questionSender role to a new address.
Fallback payable function that lets the contract receive ether from any caller.
Caller address used for access control checks and as the recipient of balance transfers.
Transaction origin compared with msg.sender inside Try, making the guard bypassable by a malicious intermediary contract.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) inside Try drains the entire contract balance to the untrusted caller.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) inside StopGame drains the entire contract balance to the owner.
Answer string supplied to Try, hashed and compared against responseHash.
Question string supplied to set_game and stored in question.
Answer string supplied to set_game whose hash becomes responseHash.
Question string supplied to NewQuestion and written to question.
New response hash supplied to NewQuestion and written to responseHash.
New owner address supplied to newQuestioner and assigned to questionSender.

edges.reason: require(msg.sender == tx.origin) makes Try's entry guard depend on the untrusted tx.origin and is bypassable through an intermediary contract.
msg.sender is compared with tx.origin to gate execution of Try.
_response is hashed with keccak256 and compared against responseHash inside Try.
responseHash is read to validate the supplied answer in Try.
Try executes the full-balance transfer when the hash matches and msg.value > 3 ether.
The whole contract balance is sent to the untrusted msg.sender before state is finalized.
set_game records msg.sender as questionSender, granting ownership of the game to the first caller.
_response is hashed and written into responseHash inside set_game.
_question is stored into the question state variable inside set_game.
set_game writes the responseHash state variable.
set_game writes the questionSender state variable.
StopGame reads questionSender to verify msg.sender is the owner.
msg.sender must equal questionSender for StopGame to proceed.
StopGame transfers the entire balance to msg.sender.
Untrusted msg.sender receives this.balance in StopGame.
NewQuestion compares msg.sender against questionSender before modifying the game.
msg.sender authorization gates the state updates in NewQuestion.
_responseHash parameter is written into the responseHash state variable.
_question parameter is written into the question state variable.
NewQuestion overwrites responseHash with an owner-chosen value.
newQuestioner reads questionSender to check the caller is the current owner.
msg.sender must equal questionSender for the ownership transfer to execute.
newAddress parameter becomes the new owner address.
newQuestioner writes the questionSender state variable, transferring ownership.
Fallback function accepts ether from any caller without restriction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _response is only used to compute the hash checked inside Try.
Parameter _question is only stored in the question state variable by set_game.
Parameter _response is only hashed into responseHash by set_game.
Parameter _question is only written to the question state variable by NewQuestion.
Parameter _responseHash is only written to responseHash by NewQuestion.
Parameter newAddress is only assigned to questionSender by newQuestioner.
